description: Named edges of the active part (or part_id), one row per chain between two stamped faces: key and name ("plate.top~boss.side", with [k] when that pair meets in several chains), faceNameA, faceNameB, faceKeyA, faceKeyB (the same keys list_faces returns, so centres and normals agree), mid, length, closed, chains, ordinal. The name is the stable edge reference: it survives edits that keep the two faces, where the old eN ordinals renumbered after any earlier change; pass it to select_edges { names }, pick_next { keys }, or write edgesNamed(part, name) in a script. A bare pair is every chain of that pair; "[k]" one chain; "*" a glob on either side. Rows come from the mesh that is shown (the rollback bar included), so they agree with list_edges. frame is "local", the same part frame as list_faces and list_edges. filter { between: [faceKeyA, faceKeyB], minLength, maxLength, bbox } and page { offset, limit } as on list_edges.

filter.description: Keep only matching edges. Every given field must hold.

bbox.description: Edges whose midpoint lies inside this box (part local, mm)

between.description: Edges shared by these two faces (list_faces keys, either order)

maxLength.description: Longest edge in mm to keep

minLength.description: Shortest edge in mm to keep

page.description: One page of rows. The result carries total (rows after the filter), returned, offset, and limit, and nextOffset when another page remains (pass it as the next offset). list_faces uses offset 0 and limit 100 when page or limit is omitted. Other lists return every remaining row when limit is omitted.

limit.description: Rows to return. list_faces defaults to 100. Other lists return every remaining row when this is omitted.

offset.description: Rows to skip. 0 starts at the first row. list_faces also accepts the previous result's nextOffset.

name: list_feature_edges
